extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia page (here: 'Apple TV comedy'), including prerequisites for creation, searching for existing coverage, and troubleshooting visibility or deletion issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not autoconfirmed you cannot create a new article; consider alternative submission routes (article wizard or requesting a new article) if you cannot meet the account requirement immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Apple TV comedy" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to find related pages which may indicate existing coverage or appropriate place to add content or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect a recently created page is missing, wait briefly or use the purge function to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check different capitalizations before creating a new page; if appropriate, create a redirect instead of a separate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons in the log to understand whether recreation is appropriate and what changes would be needed to meet Wikipedia's policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create an article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer guided creation, the article wizard helps produce a draft; requesting a new article is another channel for proposing content.
